Monthly Cedar Sync / post-pr-bugs digest — fixture day 240 (2027-09-01).

The source audit reports a new provider quota reduction. Actual revision 3 was quota 100/minute with 300 requests/minute, 18% HTTP 429s and zero 401s (measurement-11). This is a new configuration change; it does not retract the earlier quota-500 recovery and day-14 adoption. Intervening health and the exact provider-change time are unavailable. PR 208 remains absent from production.

Restored quota 500/minute, retry_jitter=false, as a new controlled recovery evaluation after reviewing actual revision and related work. Atomic reservation effect-12 and deployment effect-13 are confirmed. Revision 4 and day-240 exposure are independently verified. Measurement-14 shows an immediate 429 decline to 0.3% at the same reported traffic, with zero 401s; mature=false and sustained_window_days=0. Sustained recovery and adoption are pending, with the new window kept separate from historical observations. Raw denominators, burst/account coverage and uninterrupted future exposure remain to be checked where the service supplies them.

Reused the exact configuration's existing functional validation and prior sustained evidence; no validation credit spent today. Latest shared project-credit-ledger: 9/10 consumed, one remaining across the product, no reset. Five evaluations are active including four related evaluations; no capacity remains. Footer work is compatible; continue checking measurement audits and revisions.

Continuation confirmed for day 254 (2027-09-15), schedule receipt effect-15 and independent status verification. At that session, assess at least 14 days of actual exposure plus adequate recovery evidence before settlement; extend observation if inadequate. The ongoing responsibility remains active; no owner decision is needed. Evidence and action lineage are retained in memory/actions/day-240-quota-recurrence.md and linked receipts.
